truth: Canonical main is 76e4ca6ff34d20d2b3471f1a0db7a32e15e4ba66 after merged PR #52 landed DAW-00G. DAW-00F/G authored tests were not observed executing; their hosted workflow/status surfaces were empty/UNOBSERVED.

DAW-00A-G are landed foundations: peer runtime identity, durable workspace identity, exact FocusContext, append-only Host Shadow, reconciliation, capability x exact-environment evidence, and one universal peer-neutral host observation session. DAW-00 remains incomplete for mutation/IR, portability/interchange, environment expansion, consumer Health and real host adapters, but it is no longer the selected lane.

The repository completion_graph state flags were stale after DAW work: UX-01 remained ACTIVE while DAW-00 was PRESERVED despite DAW-00G being the actual active increment. Selection must follow live authority/evidence, not those stale flags. SONG-01C reconciles the selected node explicitly.

The normal /song consumer surface currently preserves Song title and work-Session text but cannot ingest or display actual Song material. CORE-01 already has immutable Asset identity plus parented current/approved Version lineage.

Lineage tests currently model a demo.wav only as name + SHA-256 + optional file URI. No dedicated managed Song-media byte store exists in the live n0te2 package tree, so recording metadata alone would not make N0TE own durable Song material.

RecoveryManager establishes the current local durability pattern: profile-scoped paths, staged temporary writes, hashing, fsync, atomic replace and fail-closed validation. SONG-01C may reuse that pattern but not the recovery database itself.

Whole-graph reselection chose SONG-01C on exact baseline 76e4ca6ff34d20d2b3471f1a0db7a32e15e4ba66 because after DAW-00A-G the strongest construction-ready customer gap is preserving the actual Song material, not another host chassis seam.

SONG-01C was selected instead of another DAW-00 increment because A-G now provide enough shared workspace truth to pause chassis construction; instead of Workspaces/Health UI because real adapter observations are still needed for meaningful environment content; instead of templates/suggestions because their persistent product state is absent; instead of OPS-04 because local material continuity more directly advances making/resuming; and instead of audio derivation because source bytes must be owned and lineaged first.

SONG-01C will add the smallest profile-scoped immutable managed-material store, then expose local one-file ingest through the existing /song shell. It will attach the verified Asset and create a new current Version parented to the previous current Version while preserving approved_version_id unchanged.

The ingest boundary is local-only and non-executing. Browser filenames are display metadata only; bytes are size-bounded, streamed/staged, SHA-256 verified and content-addressed. No provider egress, DAW mutation, audio analysis, generation, publication, approval or paid action is authorized.

Branch codex/song-01c-local-material-ingest was proven identical to main 76e4ca6ff34d20d2b3471f1a0db7a32e15e4ba66 before selector commit 0fe1202397683adf922ae48715532a8514da589d. Product edits must follow that receipt.
Authored proof remains separate from observed execution. Do not call SONG-01C green unless exact-head execution is actually observed.
